description_en: Creates a dialog flow unit by calling the CreateDialog operation
description_zh: 调用CreateDialog接口新增对话单元
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot create-dialog --instance-id chatbot-cn-7QuUfaqMQe --dialog-name '测试002' --api-version 2017-10-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDialog

parameters.help_en: The ID of the chatbot instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the dialog flow. The name can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 对话流名称，长度限制64个字符
parameters.name: dialog_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the dialog flow. The description can be up to 120 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 对话流描述，长度限制120个字
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key on the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不传时访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

DialogId.description_en: The ID of the dialog flow
